Initial release of work-productivity-skill-vetter-workflow-helper:

- Provides practical workflows, checklists, and templates for Skill Vetter-style tasks.
- Supports bug fixing, hardening setup and safety, reliability improvements, and creating adjacent skills.
- Uses validated demand with 8 online signals across 3 source families.
- Ensures outputs are actionable, local-hardware friendly, and tailored to user needs.
- Includes clear validation steps, assumptions, and next-step guidance.
